release_target.commit_note: The reviewed merge head, supplied as --commit when the record is built. There is no hosted deployment.

rollback_target.why_this_commit: The last integrated head recorded as validated before the world-aware stack (#14-#17). Move it forward once a later head has passed this checklist.
rollback_target.store_action: Restore the pre-upgrade store backup. Migration 0003 is forward-only and this commit's code refuses a newer database, so code rollback alone doesn't work.
rollback_target.evidence_action: Keep all capsules and evaluation evidence. Capsules replay offline and are never rewritten.

runtime.note: Single local coordinator on SQLite. No authenticated service exists.

dependency.note: Lock digests are computed from the files when a record is built.

live_capability.note: No authorization, key, model or spending cap has been provided. Mocked evaluations never change this.
